name: Green Flame Fist
body:
School evocation; Level druid 4, magus 3, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range see text
Target see text
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Fort negates; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

One of your hands, or a weapon you are holding bursts into a strange green flame which sheds light equal to that of a torch. With a successful melee touch attack you deal 3d6 fire damage plus 1 point of fire damage per caster level. The target must then make a Fortitude save or catch fire for 1 round per caster level and take 3d6+ 1 per caster level fire damage each round. A successful Fortitude save each round halves the damage. A creature can only be suffering from one instance of this effect at a time. You can also choose to add this effect to a natural or manufactured weapon you possess, triggering when the weapon deals damage to an opponent rather than as a melee touch attack.
